subject: MAP: security checkpoint — DPA exhibit & retention options
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@latitudefin.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: MAP security checkpoint — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention clarifications

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is compiling a MAP so we can align on the close timeline. A few security items came up that we need to lock into the MAP before legal will move to signature:

- SOC 2 status and expected certification window (we need ETA + scope: CC1-CC6 coverage)
- SIG/CAIQ questionnaire: can you provide a completed mapping or an ETA for delivery?
- DPA: our counsel asked for a short exhibit listing retention windows (30 / 180 / 365) and whether Redwood supports data residency in US-only regions
- Evidence: sample audit logs and a sample SOC 2 assertion would be helpful for our reviewers

I've attached our risk checklist (latitudefin-risk-asks.pdf) to show how we capture acceptance criteria. Can you confirm what you can commit to in the MAP and propose dates for the security gates?

Goal: align on MAP milestones so we can target an internal exec signoff on 2028-05-02.

Cheers,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Vendor Risk — Latitude Financial
olivia.barnes@latitudefin.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: latitudefin-risk-asks.pdf (pdf, 124KB)

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP security checkpoint — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention clarifications

Thanks Olivia — looping in Kimberly (legal) and Neha (security) to answer precisely. Quick commitments from my side:

- We'll provide a current SOC 2 status update and a copy of the most recent assertion where available.
- Completed CAIQ mapping or a redline-able SIG export by next week.
- We can propose DPA exhibits with the 3 retention-window options; Redwood supports US region residency for hosted customers.
- I added proposed MAP milestones below (tentative):
  * 2028-04-20: CAIQ / SOC2 snapshot delivered to Latitude
  * 2028-04-25: DPA exhibit options and redline to counsel
  * 2028-05-01: Final MAP signoff and internal exec approval

Kimberly / Neha — can you confirm SLA around evidence delivery and whether a 180-day default retention is standard or requires an exception?

Rafael
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com

--- Forwarded attachment: latitudefin-risk-asks.pdf ---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@latitudefin.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP security checkpoint — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention clarifications

Hi Olivia,

Appreciate the clear checklist — I've reviewed and summarized our position for the MAP below. I'll attach a proposed DPA with three exhibit options (redline_dpa_exhibits.xlsx).

1) SOC 2
- Status: Type II in-progress; fieldwork completed 2028-03, final report expected 2028-06-10.
- Scope: CC1-CC6 coverage for the hosted Redwood API and Console. We'll provide an interim SOC 2 snapshot for review by 2028-04-20 (contains control descriptions and testing summary).

2) SIG / CAIQ
- We maintain a current CAIQ export. I can deliver a mapped CAIQ + short gap commentary by 2028-04-20. If you prefer a full SIG export, we can produce that by 2028-04-22.

3) DPA & retention exhibits
- We'll provide three exhibit templates: 30 days, 180 days (our recommended default), and 365 days. For hosted customers, US-region residency is supported; private deployments can be scoped per MAP.
- Default proposal for the MAP: 180-day retention for non-production logs and 365 days for compliance artifacts (SOC 2 artifacts retained per audit requirements). If Latitude needs a shorter retention for specific datasets we can add carve-outs in Exhibit B.

4) Evidence and attachments
- Sample audit logs: we can provide redacted samples and a schema (delivery 2028-04-20).
- SOC 2 assertion: interim assertion package (redacted) on 2028-04-20.

Proposed MAP security milestones (finalize in MAP doc):
- 2028-04-20: Deliver CAIQ + SOC2 snapshot + sample logs
- 2028-04-25: Deliver DPA exhibits for legal redline
- 2028-04-28: Counsel-level redline resolution
- 2028-05-01: MAP signoff and procurement handoff

I'll attach the DPA exhibit spreadsheet and a short guidance note. Rafael — we should plan a 30-minute walkthrough with Latitude's counsel on 4/26 if possible.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: redline_dpa_exhibits.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@latitudefin.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Apr 2028 11:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP security checkpoint — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention clarifications

Hi Olivia (and team),

Quick technical clarifications to support the MAP and the evidence bundle: 

- Audit logs: our standard export includes API request id, timestamp, user identifier (redacted on sample), action type, and response codes. Logs are WORM for the retention window defined in the DPA exhibit.
- Encryption and keys: data at rest is encrypted using AES-256. For hosted customers we offer a managed KMS; bring-your-own-key (BYOK) via customer-managed KMS is available on Dedicated/Private tiers.
- Data residency: U.S. regions (us-west-2, us-east-1) supported for hosted. For EU residency we have a private deployment option — would need the MAP to specify that requirement.
- Deletion semantics: soft-delete for 30 days (recoverable) then hard-delete per retention exhibit; we can produce deletion receipts for specific records on request (requires a support playbook).

For the MAP, we'll prepare a compact evidence bundle: redacted SOC2 artifacts, CAIQ mapping, and a 1-page technical runbook for retention/deletion flows. Delivery ETA: 2028-04-20.

If Latitude confirms the preferred retention window (30 / 180 / 365) and whether BYOK is required, we will bake those specifics into Exhibit B and the technical runbook.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Staff Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@latitudefin.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP security checkpoint — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention clarifications

Thanks all — this is helpful and aligns with our internal risk appetite. Latitude prefers the 180-day default for most logs and 365 days for compliance artifacts. We do not require BYOK for initial production but may request it for a future Dedicated deployment.

Next steps from our side: I'll share counsel availability for a 4/26 call; please send the CAIQ + SOC2 snapshot and the DPA exhibits bundle by 4/20 as noted. Once we receive those, legal will aim to return a redline within 3 business days.

Olivia
